name: voxel-fps
description: Fast-paced 3D Voxel FPS Capture The Flag multiplayer game with destructible terrain, WW2 weapons, and tactical AI bots built with Three.js, React, and TypeScript.

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild scripts/admin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/admin.cjs --log-level=error
scripts.pretest: esbuild src/server/serverWorld.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/tests/serverWorld.cjs --log-level=error && esbuild src/server/serverBot.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/tests/serverBot.cjs --external:./serverWorld --log-level=error && esbuild src/shared/types.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/tests/sharedTypes.cjs --log-level=error
